description:
You are an energy modeler tasked with a specific retrofit for the executive top floor of the '4StoreyBuilding'. The building owner wants to install high-performance dynamic glass on the top floor only to address overheating, while keeping standard windows on the lower floors.

Task requirements:
1. Create a NEW Glass Type in the project library. Do NOT modify the existing default glass.
   - Name it whatever you like (e.g., 'HighPerf-Top').
   - Set Glass Conduct (U-Value) to 0.24 Btu/(hr·ft²·°F).
   - Set Shading Coefficient (SC) to 0.25.

2. Assign this new glass type to ALL windows on the Top Floor (zones starting with 'T.').

3. Ensure windows on the Ground (G.*) and Middle (M.*) floors remain unchanged (they should use the original glass type).

4. Run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to update results.
5. Save the project.

No step-by-step UI instructions provided. You must navigate the eQUEST Building Shell components and Library independently.
